{{Top}}
A '''ready room''' was a room in bases or [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] where flight crew members could relax, freshen up, and hold briefings and debriefings. One such room could be found in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Case for Rebellion">{{SWRadio|The Case for Rebellion}}</ref> Another was [[Ready Room 14]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starship [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> At least one was also present on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Ready for Takeoff">{{FFGTCG|set=Ready for Takeoff|cardname=Death Star Ready Room|link=rogue-squadron/ready-for-takeoff/death-star-ready-room-r1239}}</ref>
